contribution_types.description:
I spent 1 hour speaking with Master Bico Duro, my capoeira instructor 

He runs a children education program here in Bahia, Brazil where he teaches them capoeira after they are done with normal school hours to keep them off the streets while learning something useful

I will be helping him film a 12 weeks / one lesson per week capoeira course and then taking the curriculum and conducting them when I am back in USA 

Attendees can come to attend for free. They can donate whatever they want in a donation jar. 

Proceeds will go towards helping finance the children program. 

Meanwhile our @⁨<guild>[project] Agroverse⁩ cacao bags will be on display during the capoeira lessons. Proceeds from the sale of those will be directed to our DAO’s coffers 

Capoeira seems like a good alternative for folks who likes doing CrossFit but don’t want to have such a pricey experience 

Also it is something that they could do by themselves at home without any equipment but just their body weight 

Since it’s a 12 lessons course, it also provides a good reason for them to keep coming back if they haven’t purchased our cacao nibs yet 🤩🙏

https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1ARU9ZeKam/?

Bico duro spent 2 hours in front of the camera for capoeira advanced class filming

https://youtu.be/zLPVWP5WQOg?feature=shared
Me and Bico Duro spent 15 minutes taking photos for PR marketing materials
Mestre Bico Duro spent 5 minutes promoting our partnership on Facebook
